result.reason: The operative language establishes a mutual cap using the preferred greater-of formula and leaves all specified Excluded Claims uncapped, while preserving the payment-obligation treatment. It therefore exceeds the fallback minimum, although it does not fully achieve the preferred position because no mutual exclusion of indirect or consequential damages is included and the lookback runs from the triggering event rather than the claim. The revisions are confined to the liability allocation and are professionally drafted; however, “not subject to any limitation of liability” could more precisely say “not subject to the cap” to avoid affecting other limitations.
